Congressman Patronis Fights to Defend the Second Amendment | Representative Jimmy Patronis Skip to main content Congressman Patronis Fights to Defend the Second Amendment August 12, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. – On Tuesday, Congressman Jimmy Patronis (R-FL) joined nearly 50 of his Republican colleagues in Congress in signing a bicameral letter led by Congressman Andrew Clyde and Senator Steve Daines urging Attorney General Todd Blanche and the Department of Justice (DOJ) to defend a landmark victory for the Second Amendment. The lawmakers are calling on the Department of Justice to stand with the Constitution and not appeal a major Second Amendment victory. On August 5, a federal court in Texas ruled that the federal government can no longer require registration of suppressors, short-barreled rifles, short-barreled shotguns, and certain other firearms after Congress eliminated the related National Firearms Act taxes. The lawmakers are urging the DOJ to let the ruling stand nationwide, end unnecessary federal red tape, and protect the constitutional rights of gun owners. “Law-abiding Americans shouldn’t have to beg the federal government for permission to exercise a constitutional right,” said Congressman Patronis.  “This is consistent with everything I’ve fought for in Congress, from national reciprocity for concealed carry to repealing the Hughes Amendment. The Second Amendment ‘shall not be infringed,’ and I’ll continue fighting every day to stop Washington from putting unnecessary restrictions on our rights. The DOJ should respect the Constitution and let this historic ruling stand.” Congressman Patronis remains committed to fighting federal overreach and to ensuring the constitutional rights of Americans are protected. Congressman Jimmy Patronis Advances Legislation to Lock the Clock | Representative Jimmy Patronis Skip to main content Congressman Jimmy Patronis Advances Legislation to Lock the Clock July 15, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C.-  Late Tuesday evening, Congressman Jimmy Patronis (R-FL) advanced the  Sunshine Protection Act , legislation that would make daylight saving time permanent nationwide and end the outdated twice yearly practice of changing the clocks.  “Washington has a bad habit of making simple things harder than they need to be,” said Congressman Patronis. “Changing the clocks twice a year is one of those pointless headaches Americans are ready to leave behind. Families deserve consistency, not another government inconvenience disrupting their daily lives. The transition to Daylight Saving Time has been linked to more car accidents, sleep deprivation, and other health risks, which is why I was proud to co-sponsor this legislation. I want to thank Senator Rick Scott and Congressman Vern Buchanan for leading the charge on this commonsense bill. It’s time for Congress to catch up, end this outdated practice once and for all, and give the American people one less headache.” The Sunshine Protection Act would: Make Daylight Saving Time permanent year-round. Allow states to opt out of the change if they pass legislation prior to federal action. The legislation passed 308-117 and moves to the Senate for a vote. To view H.R. 139 the Sunshine Protection Act click  here .   ### Media Newsletter Subscribe Press Releases Back to top button

Congressman Patronis Advances NDAA to Strengthen America's Military | Representative Jimmy Patronis Skip to main content Congressman Patronis Advances NDAA to Strengthen America's Military July 23, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C.-  Wednesday afternoon, Congressman Jimmy Patronis (R-FL) voted to advance the Fiscal Year 2027  National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), legislation that ensures America’s Armed Forces remain the most capable and lethal fighting force in the world.  “We owe an incredible debt of gratitude to the men and women who wear our nation's uniform,”  said Congressman Patronis.   “Their willingness to defend our freedoms demands that we give them every tool, every resource, and every advantage needed to accomplish their mission and return home safely. The National Defense Authorization Act helps ensure our military remains the most capable fighting force in the world. I'll always stand with our warfighters, their families, and fight to keep America safe.” The NDAA includes nearly $135 million in authorized funding for key military projects across Northwest Florida, including: $87.8 million to build a new testing facility at Eglin Air Force Base that will help develop next generation military technology. $43 million to improve Eglin Air Force Base's power system and microgrid, making the base more reliable and resilient. $4.1 million to design a Child Development Center at Naval Air Station Whiting Field, providing better childcare for military families. The NDAA defends our heroes by: Fully authorizing President Trump's top defense priorities and advancing more than 65 executive and legislative proposals. Authorizing funding for a 5–7% pay raise and strengthening support for military families. Rebuilding military strength with more munitions and next generation weapons. Deterring China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea through peace through strength. Cutting Pentagon waste while supporting American defense manufacturing and jobs.
